name: guideme-guide
description: The generated GuideME guide (scripts/guide-to-guideme.py): open it with GuideME's generic book, then jump to representative pages by command. Every page must render without GuideME's red compile-error boxes; recipes draw as crafting grids; links and item links show as link text.

steps.label: open the guide with the generic book

steps.name: index
steps.look: front page 'BuildCraft Guide Book': intro line, Contents list of 8 sections (Getting Started ... Robots); sidebar shows the same sections with icons

steps.name: power-section

steps.name: quarry
steps.look: Quarry page: big quarry icon floated right, lore paragraph with Mining Well / Land Mark links, 'Information' heading, red/green coloured LED words

steps.name: quarry-recipe
steps.look: the Quarry crafting grid, then 'Mining Tier' and 'Power' headings; no red error box

steps.name: plug-gate
steps.look: Logic Gates page: a wrapping row of gate crafting recipes; no red error boxes

steps.name: wire
steps.look: Pipe Wires page; further down a bulleted list of 16 coloured wire item links

steps.name: trigger
steps.look: a trigger page (no item icon) with prose and links

steps.name: board
